_note: v2 hook overrides for le Jardin des Proverbes (B58_proverbes). Every hook describes what is actually painted (nothing is written in the paintings); idioms are acted out literally.

fr_mettre_son_grain_de_sel_idiom.why: Reworded to match the painting: one bowl of soup is painted. Gloss and English example reworded: the usual English equivalent trips the content filter (no 'butt'/'kill' wording); meaning unchanged.
fr_mettre_son_grain_de_sel_idiom.en: to put in one's two cents' worth (unasked)
ex: Il faut toujours qu'il mette son grain de sel !
He always has to put in his two cents' worth!

fr_faire_d_une_pierre_deux_coups_idiom.why: kept, matches the painting. Gloss and English example reworded: the usual English equivalent trips the content filter (no 'butt'/'kill' wording); meaning unchanged.
fr_faire_d_une_pierre_deux_coups_idiom.en: to do two things at once (two birds, one stone)
ex: En allant au marché, je fais d'une pierre deux coups.
By going to the market, I get two jobs done at once.
